change: deploy gate: three independent kinds of check before any automatic deploy

checks.name: production serves what this tree is
checks.command: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const want=cp.execSync('git rev-parse HEAD',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().slice(0,7);const h=cp.execSync('curl -sS --max-time 25 https://progress.apcsexamprep.com/api/health',{encoding:'utf8'});const got=JSON.parse(h).commit;if(got!==want)throw new Error('production serves '+got+', this tree is '+want);console.log('PRODUCTION SERVES THIS TREE '+got);"

checks.command: node -e "const cp=require('child_process');const u=require('./utils.js');const h=cp.execSync('curl -sSL --max-time 40 https://apcsexamprep.com/pages/ap-cyber-unit-3-lesson-3-exercise-2',{encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:2e7});const m=h.match(/<script>\\s*\\(function \\(\\) \\{\\s*\\/\\/ handle ordinal[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/);if(!m)throw new Error('map snippet not served');const w={};new Function('window',m[0].replace(/^<script>/,'').replace(/<\\/script>$/,''))(w);const live=w.APCS_CYBER_LESSON(3,3);const server=u.pageFromHandle('ap-cyber-unit-3-lesson-3-exercise-2').lesson;if(live!==server)throw new Error('live '+live+' vs server '+server);console.log('AGREE '+live);" 2>/dev/null
